description: Synthetic comments written for this project (not YouTube data) for an independent creator's review of a fictional cooperative board game (not sponsored). Final hold-out validation set for topic discovery and assignment: authored separately from t1-topics-v1 and t2-topics-v1 (different product domain, comments, taxonomy and gold), with the gold written before any provider run on it. Same schema and gold semantics as t1/t2: gold taxonomy, one gold topic disposition per non-spam comment and the sentiment toward its primary topic; overall classification labels are oracle inputs, not a classifier benchmark. Test fixtures only.

taxonomy.name: Rules and learning curve
taxonomy.definition: How easy the game is to learn and teach: rulebook clarity, player aids and first-game confusion.

taxonomy.name: Difficulty and balance
taxonomy.definition: How hard the game is to win, how much luck decides outcomes and whether the heroes are evenly matched.

taxonomy.name: Component quality
taxonomy.definition: The physical production: cards, miniatures, boards, tokens, dice and the box insert.

taxonomy.name: Art and graphic design
taxonomy.definition: Illustrations, iconography and how readable the text and symbols are.

taxonomy.name: Setup and play time
taxonomy.definition: How long setup, teardown and a full game take.

taxonomy.name: Solo play
taxonomy.definition: Playing the game alone, including the one-player rules and how well they work.

taxonomy.name: Player count scaling
taxonomy.definition: How the game changes between two, three, four or more players at the table.

taxonomy.name: Replayability and variety
taxonomy.definition: How much variety the scenarios, events and heroes offer over many plays.

taxonomy.name: Theme and story
taxonomy.definition: The setting, narrative and how strongly the game makes players feel part of its world.
